ideas.title: The George Santos Investigation: A Deeper Dive
ideas.description: This story would investigate the alleged insider trading and Kalshi betting scheme involving former Congressman George Santos.
ideas.angle: The specific investigative angle would be to examine the extent of Santos' involvement in the alleged scheme and potential connections to other individuals or organizations.
questions: What was the nature of Santos' involvement in the alleged scheme?
Were there any other individuals or organizations involved?
ideas.insight: This story matters because it involves a former elected official and potential corruption. The investigation could uncover a larger pattern of wrongdoing and abuse of power.
